subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on Japanese industrial production, items 24–32
subfiles.about: An archival index summarizes 1941 papers on Japanese chemicals, fuels, metals, engineering production, strategic purchases, and industrial conversion.
subfiles.summary: Items 24-32 cover Japanese gas companies' coke/coal output, a Chilean iodine purchase bid amid frozen funds and profiteering concerns, and Harrison's Bern telegrams on Mitsubishi's chemical combine, magnesium expansion, steel/aluminum output, and an auto plant converted to aviation and marine engines.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet on Japan’s manufacture of high-octane gasoline
subfiles.from: Department of State, Far Eastern Affairs (Maxwell M. Hamilton)
subfiles.about: The sheet directs researchers to a record of a conversation about whether Japan possessed factories and refineries capable of producing high-octane gasoline.
subfiles.summary: Indexes a January 1940 note on Japan's high-octane gasoline capacity, discussed between Congressman Fish and Hamilton, filed at 894.24/820.

interest: Shows 1940-41 U.S. intelligence on Japan's chemical, fuel, and metal industries, including iodine purchases and magnesium expansion.
